news.title: Musk urges top AI labs, Chinese companies to test each other's models amid calls for slowdown
news.summary: Elon Musk called for the leading AI labs to peer review each others' models before they're released to the public as a way to evaluate their safety.

news.title: Saudi pipeline closure is a brief interruption that will last days, U.S. Energy Secretary tells CNBC
news.summary: The East-West pipeline sustained damage in a drone attack launched from Iraq. The Saudis closed the pipeline after it was damaged in the attack.

news.title: Scott Bessent defends Treasury intervention, Trump economy in contentious House hearing

news.title: 10-year Treasury yield hits highest level since 2007 as traders bet a Fed rate hike is coming
news.summary: The sell-off in U.S. government debt is deepening as investors price in an interest rate hike this week. The sell-offs are being driven by fears that the Federal Reserve will raise its benchmark rate.

news.title: U.S. crude oil tops $106 as market awaits updates on Saudi pipeline outage
news.summary: Houthi militants in Yemen carried out renewed strikes on Saudi Arabia this week. Iran-backed Houthi militants are fighting against the Saudi-led coalition in Yemen.

news.title: AI stocks are rebounding. One analyst says there’s no spending slowdown in sight.

news.title: Why investors need to learn the difference between uncertainty and risk in today’s market
news.summary: Hedge-fund founder Alec Litowitz says investor should make their identity about being adaptive, rather than trying to be right. Litowitz: Investors should be adaptive, not just right.

news.title: Is the two-decade era of low interest rates over? The Fed has to decide.
news.summary: High bond yields could be the result of temporary shocks — or something much longer-lasting. High bond yields are a sign that investors are worried about the future of the global economy.
